execution: sequential; all commands used the locked offline workspace and one cargo job

commands.note: One test exercises four combinations of runtime/queue and prior-cancel/no-prior-cancel. The captured panic messages are intentional mutex poisoning.

identity_comparison.method: Compare-Object on Path and Hash, using the same input file list captured before testing
identity_comparison.scope: Existing crates/**/*.rs, crates/**/Cargo.toml and build.rs selected before the run, root Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml and tests/fixtures/generated/minimal-035.dex. The comparison does not independently detect new files created after the input list was captured.

limitations: Targeted local tests only; no full workspace, cross-platform, production worker, complete concurrency or release qualification is claimed.
